title: The Unreliable Witness
text:
Memoir occupies an uneasy border between autobiography and fiction. Its author must reconstruct the past from fragments of memory, which are notoriously unreliable and often reshaped by the very act of recollection. Writers in this genre therefore tend to acknowledge the gaps in their own testimony rather than pretend to a seamless accuracy.

Critics have questioned whether such candour is a virtue or a rhetorical device. Some argue that confessing uncertainty grants the writer an unearned moral authority, while others see it as the only honest posture available. What is clear is that the genre rewards a particular kind of self-scrutiny, one that treats memory as evidence to be interrogated rather than as a record to be trusted.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what must a memoir author do in order to recount the past?
According to paragraph two, what do some critics argue that confessing uncertainty grants the writer?
What does the passage imply about memoirists who pretend to seamless accuracy?
options: They are the most honest writers in the genre
They overlook how unreliable memory can be
They avoid writing about the past altogether
They follow the conventions of fiction closely

questions.text: Why does the final sentence describe memory as 'evidence to be interrogated'?
options: Because memory should be presented in court
Because memory should be questioned rather than accepted uncritically
Because memory is always completely accurate
Because readers must be questioned by the author

not able to be trusted to give accurate information
the quality of being open and honest, even about difficult things

paragraph_translations: A memória ocupa uma fronteira incômoda entre a autobiografia e a ficção. O autor precisa reconstruir o passado a partir de fragmentos da memória, que são notoriamente pouco confiáveis e muitas vezes remodelados pelo próprio ato de lembrar. Por isso, os escritores desse gênero tendem a reconhecer as lacunas do próprio testemunho, em vez de fingir uma precisão perfeita.

Os críticos têm questionado se essa franqueza é uma virtude ou um recurso retórico. Alguns argumentam que confessar a incerteza concede ao escritor uma autoridade moral não merecida, enquanto outros a veem como a única postura honesta disponível. O que está claro é que o gênero recompensa um tipo particular de autocrítica, que trata a memória como evidência a ser interrogada, e não como um registro em que se deva confiar.
